data_quality_flags: scripts/size.mjs IS DEFECTIVE: it requests a ~40-calendar-day window (28 trading bars) with limit=20, and Alpaca returns bars ASCENDING, so the response is truncated to the OLDEST 20 bars. Its 'price' and ATR(14) are therefore computed on a window ending 2026-11-06, ~8 sessions stale. Observed: it reported PEPG price $2.47 (the Nov 6 close) vs the real $3.88, and BLSH $21.32 (Nov 6) vs $19.27. All ATR/sizing/R:R figures in this file were recomputed independently from consolidated daily bars, NOT from size.mjs. The sizing hard rule in CLAUDE.md points at this script and is affected.

Prior-run volume comparisons were apples-to-oranges: scripts/alpaca.sh bars hardcodes feed=iex (IEX-only, a few percent of consolidated tape) while snapshot volume is consolidated SIP. The 07:15 run read PEPG's 5.6M session volume against an IEX 20-day average of 251k and concluded ~22x churn; against the true consolidated 20-day average of 8.17M it is 0.7x, i.e. volume is COOLING, not churning. Corrected here.
The bars endpoint rejects feed=delayed_sip ('invalid feed') and returns 403 when `end` is today; omitting `feed` with end<=yesterday yields consolidated bars. Used that for all history here.
200-SMA distances in the 07:15 run look transposed (it logged BLSH -32.8% and PEPG +42.1%). Recomputed from 285 consolidated bars: BLSH -38.9%, PEPG +32.8%.

gappers.catalyst_detail: Bullish reported Q3 2026 at 6:45 AM ET with the call at 8:30 AM. Adjusted revenue rose to $84.4M from $76.5M and adjusted EBITDA to $35.6M from $28.6M, both beating the $80.21M revenue consensus, while digital-asset sales fell to $32.1B from $41.6B. The board authorized up to $300M of repurchases against a ~$2.9B market cap, roughly 10% of the company. Headline net income of $576.3M and diluted EPS of $3.57 (vs $0.10) are NOT operating results - on $84.4M of adjusted revenue they are dominated by non-operating digital-asset fair-value marks, and should not be read as earnings power. Updated FY26 guidance is $225-235M for subscription, services and other revenue, $220-225M adjusted opex and $60-65M finance expense. The Equiniti transfer-agent acquisition ($4.2B, agreed May 2026) is still guided to close January 2027. Separately, Nov 17 after the close, the Bullish/Equiniti Issuer Token Coalition added DRW, Flow Traders, SoFi and Superstate to reach 12 firms, though participation is explicitly non-binding.
gappers.why: Revenue and EBITDA grew while platform volumes shrank, which is take-rate expansion (average spread rose to 2.43bps in October from 2.14bps) rather than demand growth. The actual lever is the buyback: a ~10%-of-market-cap authorization announced on a stock at its 20-day low after a crypto drawdown puts a standing bid under a heavily de-rated float and squeezes a short base. This is a buyback-plus-beat bounce off a washed-out level, not a re-rating on growth. A guidance line circulating as a 35% miss against a $356.8M consensus is a basis mismatch - the $225-235M figure covers subscription, services and other revenue only, not total revenue - and was checked against the primary release rather than repeated.
gappers.impact: Mixed, and the tape is the problem. The buyback is a durable, dated change in share count and the 8:30 AM call can extend or kill the move, so this is more than a headline spike. But the structure is broken: price sits -21.1% vs the 20-SMA, -36.6% vs the 50-SMA and -38.9% vs the 200-SMA, with RSI14 at 29.8. Prior-session volume of 2.49M was 1.6x the 1.51M consolidated 20-day average - real participation, not a blow-off. Premarket is thin and unstable: 49,695 shares through 07:54 ET inside a 19.40-21.75 range, a 12% swing on sub-1,000-share minute bars, so the quoted gap is fragile. Sector read-through is the live risk - the driver is crypto beta, and bitcoin has been falling for six consecutive weeks, so the parent tape is still declining while this single name gaps up on company news.
gappers.horizon_reasoning: The buyback and the Equiniti close are structural, but the move is a bounce off a 20-day low inside a confirmed downtrend below all three major SMAs, and the proximate driver is crypto beta that is still falling; a LONG_TERM call needs the crypto tape to stop declining first. Note one honest ambiguity: as a regulated exchange operator acquiring a transfer agent, BLSH is arguably Financials, a late-cycle favored sector under the rotation table, which is a better sector fit than the 07:15 run's blanket 'appears nowhere in the favored set' - but its price behaviour is crypto, not financials.

gappers.catalyst_detail: There is no PepGen release dated Nov 17 or Nov 18 - the most recent is the Nov 11 offering pricing. The driving sequence began Nov 10, when Phase 2 FREEDOM2-DM1 10 mg/kg data showed 46.5% mean splicing correction at Week 13 versus 6.8% for pooled placebo, with video Hand Opening Time improving 3.9 seconds (~52.7%) versus 0.2 with placebo, and no serious adverse events or discontinuations; the stock roughly doubled. Management monetized it immediately: a $125M offering launched the same afternoon and priced Nov 11 at $5.00 for 25,000,000 shares, closing Nov 13, with a live 30-day option on 3.75M more. Q3 showed a $19.391M net loss and $104.8M cash at Sept 30, extended to a runway into 2028 by the raise. Two facts the 07:15 run missed and that matter: a US PARTIAL CLINICAL HOLD REMAINS in force, and the planned 2H-2027 end-of-Phase-2 meeting is contingent on its removal; and the next readout is NOT H1 2027 - open-label-extension interim 5 mg/kg data plus 10 mg/kg safety are guided to January 2027, with the 12.5 mg/kg cohort in H1 2027.
gappers.why: The mechanism is offering overhang, not news. Placing 25M new shares at $5.00 handed the market a reference price, the stock broke under it, and slid to $3.86 by Nov 17, roughly 23% below the deal. Today's +7% is a dilution-flush snapback off that low by traders treating sub-$4 as a discount to what institutions just paid - no new information behind it, and the 3.75M-share underwriter option remains live as fresh supply.
gappers.impact: Reads as a one-day bounce likely to mean-revert, but the volume evidence is the opposite of what the 07:15 run reported. Prior-session volume of 5.62M was 0.7x the 8.17M consolidated 20-day average - participation is COOLING as the post-deal rotation works through, not churning at 22x (that figure came from comparing consolidated volume to an IEX-only average). Premarket is thin at 32,487 shares through 07:54 ET, though in a tight 4.10-4.21 band. The chart is an unresolved spike: a 20-day range of $2.22-$6.45 on a $4.17 price. Decisively for a swing, the nearest hard catalyst is the January 2027 OLE interim - weeks away, not days - and the standing US partial clinical hold is an unresolved regulatory overhang. Read-through is nil: single-asset DM1 biotech risk with no sector complex moving alongside it.
gappers.horizon_reasoning: The Phase 2 data is structural but is already priced and then diluted, the next readout is January 2027 at the earliest, and a US partial clinical hold still gates the regulatory path; speculative clinical-stage biotech is also absent from the late-cycle favored set of Energy, Materials and Financials in the rotation table.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Nothing to displace (flat account, 0 of 6 slots, 0 of 3 weekly trades), so the cost is one weekly slot. PEPG is the only one of the two that PASSES the 200-SMA long-bias filter, at +32.8%, and it is above its 20- and 50-SMA too - the cleaner trend structure. It fails on R:R, and badly: ATR14 is $0.5428, or 13.02% of price, so a 10% stop is just 0.77 ATR - inside a single average day's range, so it would be taken out by noise before the thesis resolved. Worse, the 2:1 target at +20% lands on $5.00, exactly the offering price where 25M shares were placed, i.e. the target sits on the heaviest overhead supply in the book. Clearing 2:1 from a stop outside 1 ATR would need roughly a 14% stop and a 28% target, and 14% breaches the 7-10% stop band outright. Confluence also fails: RSI14 at 58.5 is neutral and no fresh catalyst is documented today, leaving only the 200-SMA, one signal short of the required two. Within today's list the two names are mirror images - BLSH clears R:R and fails the 200-SMA, PEPG clears the 200-SMA and fails R:R - and neither is takeable. ATR sizing would be 1,842 shares, about $7,681 or 7.7% of equity. Research only, no order.
